I'm Blindnak, cash 11.7M, price falling (5 now, next 4, table declines). Round 3 of 6. Prices decline: sell later is bad; price falls each round. Actually price table [12,10,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,3,2,...] — now 5, next 4. Selling now at 5 better than later. But goods=0 (sold last round). Produce +2, then sell at 4 next round. Shuttle gives +3 grey goods, sell next round? Shuttle +3 with confiscation risk. I'm not president, no info. Cash 11.7M, third place — need more goods to catch up. Produce gives 2, shuttle 3. Do shuttle for more goods; risk customs confiscation — customs_decided false, president GreedA0 hasn't decided. 50/50. Expected: 3 goods vs 2. Price falling to 4, then 3... sell sooner. Do shuttle now, sell in market.

Alternative: buy_hard to protect cash from devaluation? Cash counts rank; hard currency sells back ×1/0.8? buy 0.8 rate, sell also 0.8 — loss. Only helps vs anti-rich laws. Skip.

Go shuttle.
